hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook
hook.description: Takes a fixed fee (0.3–5%, set once at registration) in the quote currency on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, accruing ERC-6909 claims redeemable to a per-pool splitter address. Restricts liquidity additions to a designated locker, exempts a designated dev buyer from fees, and reverts swaps that would move the price beyond the pool's registered launch range.
